description: Operational questions paired with the documents that answer them. Authored by hand against the fetched corpus; relevance is judged at document level, so a query is satisfied when any chunk of a listed document is retrieved.
limitations: Single-annotator labels, no inter-annotator agreement, and a query set small enough that a few percent of recall is within noise. Treated as a regression guard and a relative comparison between retrievers, not as an absolute measure of retrieval quality.
